teaser.en: Nutgrass, the weed farmers cannot kill: dig it up and its chains of little tubers sprout again.
teaser.sw: Ndago, gugu ambalo wakulima hawawezi kuliua: ukilichimbua, minyororo yake ya viazi vidogo huchipuka tena.
teaser.dg: Ndago ziya, mbondo ambayo akurima taaweza kuiolaga: uchiitsimba, minyororo ya viazivye vidide inamera tsona.

summary.en: Ndago ziya is nutgrass, a sedge with reddish-brown flower spikes and underground chains of small tubers, notorious as one of the world's worst weeds. The Digo name ties it to water.
summary.sw: Ndago ziya ni ndago (*nutgrass*), mmea wenye vishada vya maua vya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu na minyororo ya viazi vidogo chini ya ardhi, unaojulikana sana kama mojawapo ya magugu mabaya zaidi duniani. Jina lake la Kidigo linauhusisha na maji.
summary.dg: Ndago ziya (kpwa Chingereza *nutgrass*) ni ndago yenye vitswa vya maruwa vya rangi ya kundu na dongo, na tsini ina minyororo ya viazi vidide. Inamanyikana duniani kosi dza mmwenga wa mbondo mbii zaidi. Dzina ra Chidigo rinaiika phamwenga na madzi.

about.en:
*Ndago ziya* is a low sedge with shiny, grass-like leaves and smooth three-sided stems. At the top, a spray of narrow reddish-brown to purplish spikelets sits above a few leafy bracts.

The secret is underground. Thin runners link chains of small, hard, dark tubers, each able to sprout a new plant, which is why weeding rarely gets rid of it. The Digo recognise it from the look of the whole plant.
about.sw:
*Ndago ziya* ni ndago mfupi mwenye majani yanayong'aa yanayofanana na nyasi na mashina laini ya pembe tatu. Juu kabisa, kishada cha vishada vyembamba vya maua vya rangi ya kahawia-nyekundu hadi zambarau hukaa juu ya vikombe-jani vichache.

Siri yake iko chini ya ardhi. Mashina membamba yanayotambaa huunganisha minyororo ya viazi vidogo, vigumu na vyeusi, kila kimoja kikiweza kuchipuza mmea mpya, ndiyo sababu kupalilia mara chache humwondoa. Wadigo huutambua kwa sura ya mmea mzima.
about.dg:
*Ndago ziya* ni ndago fupi yenye makodza ganayong'ala dza ga nyasi na mihi laini ya pembe tahu. Dzulu, vitswa vidide vyembamba vya maruwa, vya rangi ya kundu na dongo hadi zambarau, vinamera dzulu ya makodza mafupi machache.

Siriye iri tsini. Mihi myembamba inayoambala tsini ndiyo inayogbwira minyororo ya viazi vidide, vigumu na vya rangi ya jiza, na chila chiazi chinaweza kulavya mmea muphya. Ndiyo mana uchiiburuga mara nyinji taimala. Adigo anaimanya kpwa umbo ra mmea wosi.

where.en: It is common in farms, gardens, roadsides and open ground all along the coast, and does well in damp places.
where.sw: Ni wa kawaida mashambani, bustanini, kando ya barabara na kwenye ardhi wazi kote pwani, na hustawi vizuri sehemu zenye unyevu.
where.dg: Ni ya kawaida mindani, busitanini, kanda-kanda ya njira na phatu pha weruni pwani yosi, na inamera vinono phatu pha madzi-madzi.

uses.en: Pakia records that the Digo use the root nodules of *ndago* sedges (*Kyllinga* or *Cyperus*) to make a charm that gives magical strength in times of danger. Across Africa and Asia the fragrant tubers of nutgrass are also widely used in traditional medicine and perfumery, though no such use is recorded for the Digo.
uses.sw: Pakia anaripoti kwamba Wadigo hutumia vinundu vya mizizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kutengeneza hirizi inayotoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari. Kote Afrika na Asia, viazi vyake vyenye harufu nzuri pia hutumika sana katika tiba za jadi na utengenezaji wa manukato, ingawa hakuna matumizi kama hayo yaliyoripotiwa kwa Wadigo.
uses.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo nkuhumira vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya ndago (*Kyllinga* au *Cyperus*) kuhenda hirizi inayopha mutu nguvu za uganga wakati wa hatari. Kpwenye Afrika na Asia viazi vyenye arufu nono vya ndago ihi piya nkuhumirwa sana kpwa dawa za chienyeji na kuhenda marashi, ela takuna matumizi dza higa garigoandikpwa kpwa Adigo.

culture.en: Pakia explains that plants of fresh water and ponds carry the label *ziya*, as in *ndago ziya* and *mrinda ziya*, and glosses the name as 'aquatic sedge'. In the Mgombato dictionary *ziya* is 'lake'.
culture.sw: Pakia anaeleza kwamba mimea ya maji baridi na madimbwi hubeba kiambishi *ziya*, kama katika *ndago ziya* na *mrinda ziya*, na analifafanua jina hili kama 'ndago wa majini'. Katika kamusi ya Mgombato, *ziya* ni 'ziwa'.
culture.dg: Pakia anagomba kukala mimea ya madzi gasigo na munyu na ya madimbwi inaikpwa neno *ziya*, dza *ndago ziya* na *mrinda ziya*, na anagomba mana ga dzina hiri ni 'ndago ya madzini'. Kpwenye kamusi ya Mgombato, *ziya* ni 'ziwa' (*lake*).

names.en: Pakia records *ndago ziya*, the 'water' or 'pond' sedge. *Ndago*, the word for sedges, is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. In English it is nutgrass or watergrass. Pakia's folk-genus table places *ndago ziya* in *Fimbristylis*, another sedge genus, rather than *Cyperus rotundus*, so the identification needs checking.
names.sw: Pakia anaripoti *ndago ziya*, ndago wa 'maji' au wa 'dimbwi'. *Ndago*, neno la jamii ya ndago, hutumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *nutgrass* au *watergrass*. Jedwali la jenasi za kijadi la Pakia linamweka *ndago ziya* katika *Fimbristylis*, jenasi nyingine ya ndago, badala ya *Cyperus rotundus*, kwa hiyo utambulisho wake unahitaji kuthibitishwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *ndago ziya*, ndago ya 'madzini' au ya 'ziya'. *Ndago*, neno ra ndago zosi, rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *nutgrass* au *watergrass*. Orodha ya Pakia ya makundi ga mimea inaika *ndago ziya* kahi ya *Fimbristylis*, jenasi yanjina ya ndago, si *Cyperus rotundus*, kpwa hivyo ni lazima kulola tsona ni aina iphi hasa.

reason.sw: nao umepewa jina kutokana na madimbwi (ziya)
reason.dg: piya inaihwa kpwa sababu ya ziya

definition.en: The small swellings on the roots of these sedges.
definition.sw: Vivimbe vidogo kwenye mizizi ya ndago hawa.
definition.dg: Vitu vidide vinavyofutuka kpwenye mizi ya ndago hizi.

use.en: Made into a charm believed to give magical strength in times of danger.
use.sw: Hutengenezwa kuwa hirizi inayoaminika kutoa nguvu za kimiujiza wakati wa hatari.
use.dg: Nkuhendwa hirizi inayoaminika kupha mutu nguvu za uganga wakati wa hatari.

meaning.en: Charm; the nodules were probably named after charms because they look alike.
meaning.sw: Hirizi; huenda vinundu hivi vilipewa jina la hirizi kwa sababu vinafanana.
meaning.dg: Hirizi; anji phahi vitu hivi vikaihwa kpwa dzina ra hirizi kpwa sababu vinahalana nayo.
